name: dumbbell side lunge with shoulder press
description: A side lunge paired with an overhead press. It trains the legs and shoulders together.
instructions: Stand holding dumbbells at your shoulders.
Step out wide to one side and sit your hips back into a side lunge.
Keep the other leg straight and your chest up.
Push back to the middle and press the dumbbells overhead.
Lower to your shoulders and lunge to the other side.
